ios.desc:
Hydrofoil Surfing is THPS style wingfoil surfing game with easy to use, invisible screen controls and real-time ocean physics. Pump to generate speed, ride waves and boost airs, land spins, flips, grabs, and keep speed or sink. Unlock all locations & boards using a combo of exploration, strategy, and skill to complete all 54 goals and achievements throughout 6 unique levels.

Features:
- simple touch left/right controls
- Realistic pump cadence: generate speed or sink
- Air tricks: flips, spins, grabs
- 6 Locations (unlock as you progress)
- Performance foil boards to unlock

Modes:
- Career Mode: Unlock Locations & Boards
- Free Surf: Shred and explore

On Water Controls: 
press screen Left or Right: turn Left / Right
press lower screen left, right alternating: Pump
press screen Left + Right: Jump
press screen lower left + Right: Stall 

In Air Controls:
press screen Left or Right: turn Left / Right
press screen lower Left + Right: Back Flip
press screen upper Left + Right: Front Flip

In Air on-screen grab buttons:
- One-footer grab 
- Benihana grab
- Method grab 
- Japan Air grab 
- Melon Grab 
- Stalefish Grab

Supports game-controllersPresented by Surf Da Earf, featuring Mind Surf Engine 2.0Designed and Developed by Devin Sewell
